title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：stream　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stream 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the fisherman ① crossed the stream that no boatman in the harbour would have measured, and he said the crossing was the whole of the season. The ② stream, meaning the brook itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a stream, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ stream in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ stream at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A stream, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the fisherman said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stream was the whole of the matter, meaning the flow and not the brook. The ⑥ stream, meaning the flow and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; stream, he said, is either something you cross or the only word that means both a brook and a flow. He said the flow is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ stream had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ stream of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of measuring; stream, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stream I remember is the brook measured in the logbook, which closed in 1995 and is still measured as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ stream, my mother said in 1997, is the only brook that improves by being measured; every stream, she said, is a flow that has agreed to look like a brook. She said the flow was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小河；溪流（指渔港里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 小河；溪流（指那条小河本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：cross the stream 涉这一条小河
D. n. 小河；溪流（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 小河之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的小河之事）
F. n. 小河；溪流（指航海日志里写到、被测量的那一条）
G. n. 小河、流淌（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 流淌（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: crossed the stream that no boatman in the harbour would have measured
The stream, meaning the brook itself and not the net
the stream at the far pier
the stream was the whole of the matter
the stream had become a line in a logbook
The stream of the whole thing
A stream, my mother said in 1997

answers.why: cross the stream 意为“涉这一条小河”，1988 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯测量的一条小河做了一遍。
stream 意为“小河；溪流”，指那条小河本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被测量。
stream 意为“小河；溪流”，指渔港里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
stream 意为“小河；溪流”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stream 意为“小河、流淌”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条流淌就是那件事的全部。
stream 意为“流淌”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条小河，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stream 意为“小河；溪流”，指航海日志里写到、被测量的那一条，到 1993 年这一条成了航海日志里的一行。
stream 意为“小河之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的小河之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的测量。
stream 意为“小河；溪流”，我记得的是航海日志里测量过的那一条，1995 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一条。
stream 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，小河是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的小河。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年那位渔人涉了渔港里没有一位船工肯测量的一条小河，他说这一遍才是那个汛期的全部。（cross the stream）
那条小河，指的是那条小河本身而不是小小的渔网，经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被测量。（stream）
那处渔港里每一条小河旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。（stream）
最远那座码头那条小河，指的是他们留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（stream）
叔叔说这条流淌就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那条小河。（stream）
1997 年母亲说，小河是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的小河。（stream）
